notes.title: Release 1.1.6
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] - By yanniboi: More barks. 
[*] - By atslughorn:  Fixed LevelLeaderboardTopped achievement in LeaderboardForm.cs (#191) 
[*] - By yanniboi: Updated twitch messages. 
[*] - By yanniboi: Removed a bunch of logging and prevent unpublished level scores
[*] - By Endocrine: Achievement restriction
[*] - By CalmPewter: Enemy animation, cursor and game icon, fix chest enemy triggers
[*] - By yanniboi: Tweaked overlay opacity
[*] - By Endocrine: Correct Qonfiguration bool description for lever block 
[*] -  By yanniboi: Added a refresh button to Leaderboard. 
[*] - By Fresch:  Geyser consistency.
[*] - By Endocrine: Lever channel shader (in-game)
[*] - By Endocrine: Editor level block channel visualisation (#196)
[*] - By yanniboi: Updated Leaderboard refresh button icon, show level code on leaderboard and added more barks.
[/list]


[b]Level Channel Overlay[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44678002/b5c3c53fb9d6e1b68e46467bd45dbda025a6f930.gif[/img]

You can now see ingame which level toggles which blocks with colours and numbers.

[b]First time contribution[/b]

We were missing an achievement trigger for topping a leaderboard. @atslughorn found and fixed this for us (what a legend) and now if you are still top of a leaderboard you should be able to just view that leaderboard from the level selection page and you will unlock the achievement.

notes.title: v1.0.0
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]

- Twitch integration
- Level filtering
- Level browser pagination
- Level editor tooltips
- Steam Achievements
- First attempt at level tagging


[h3]Rework[/h3]

- New player controller to fix fps related issues.
